name: Article 193a, § 2/2
title: REPORT on amendments to Parliament’s Rules of Procedure on proxy voting during pregnancy and immediately after childbirth
part_text: Amendment 2. Voting by proxy shall be subject to the general conditions laid down in the Statute for Members of the European Parliament and to this Rule. The delegation shall authorise the proxy solely to cast the delegating Member’s vote and to represent her for the purposes of the quorum and majorities. It shall confer no other right to act on her behalf. Except for votes cast in accordance with this Rule and for quorum and majorities, no support, objection, request, signature, procedural motion or other act of the proxy under these Rules of Procedure shall be attributed to the delegating Member.
